headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE its timely payment of interest on publicly-issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations, Regulation 57.
implication: Routine debt-servicing disclosure under SEBI Reg 57 confirms the issuer's ongoing compliance with listing covenant obligations; material for debenture-holder due diligence and bond-rating surveillance.
detail: The company filed a statutory certification with the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 57 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, confirming timely payment of interest on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs) issued via public offering and listed on stock exchanges. This is a mandatory disclosure requirement for listed debt issuers to maintain transparency and bondholder confidence. The filing does not disclose the principal amount, coupon rate, or maturity date of the debentures.
